name: Tjaktja-Salka
description: Tjaktja to Salka. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: STF publishes Tjaktja-Salka as a 12 km stage, while Naturkartan official county linework is a combined 25 km Alesjaure-Salka route that must be reversed and split. OSM relation 10861494 is section-specific but not official.

STF hut coordinates do not always coincide with OSM/Naturkartan stage-boundary geometry. Tjaktja is 220-328 m from line/stage coordinates; Salka aligns closer but Naturkartan's Salka-side endpoint is about 199 m from the hut.
STF structured/page evidence and Naturkartan/OSM/text evidence conflict between 11-25 beds and 33 beds for Tjaktja.
Official sources use Tjaktjapasset and about 1150 m; OSM shelter object uses variant spelling and ele=1120.
STF gives the Abisko-Nikkaluokta route-group total as 107 km; Swedish Lapland gives 105 km. Section 4 distance remains consistently 12 km.
Multiple 2025 sources report early-season snow at/near Tjaktjapasset, but no 2026 summer snow report was available on 2026-04-29.
Run a full protected-area/Natura 2000 overlay on final section geometry before rules normalization.

facilities.name: Main bridge before Salka
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM bridge way center; Naturkartan route text says bridges cross small streams approaching Salka
facilities.description: Mapped bridge on Kungsleden before Salka in the valley south of Tjaktjapasset.
facilities.routeProximity: Around km 9.10, about 5 m from OSM relation 10861494.

facilities.name: STF Salka Mountain Cabin
facilities.description: Remote STF mountain cabin at the section end and trail junction. Services include shop, sauna, self-catering kitchen, hut-area toilets/water and safety/emergency context; no mobile coverage is reported by official sources.
facilities.routeProximity: Section end; about 21-31 m from OSM/Naturkartan nearest line points.

facilities.name: STF Tjaktja Mountain Cabin
facilities.description: Remote STF mountain cabin at the section start. It has basic self-catering mountain-cabin services and no shop; field and official sources emphasize no mobile coverage and simple facilities.
facilities.routeProximity: Section start hut; about 220-328 m from mainline/stage-boundary geometry depending on source.

facilities.name: Tjaktjapasset latrine
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM toilet node; Naturkartan shelter text confirms latrine associated with the shelter
facilities.description: Latrine by the Tjaktjapasset rest shelter.
facilities.routeProximity: Around km 3.37, about 10 m from OSM relation 10861494.

facilities.name: Tjaktjapasset Raststuga
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan rest-shelter directions coordinate; OSM shelter way center corroborates nearby at 68.019682, 18.247129
facilities.description: Rest shelter at Tjaktjapasset, Kungsleden's high pass. Naturkartan says the shelter has room for 10 people, stove, firewood and latrine; overnight stays and firewood use are for emergencies.
facilities.routeProximity: Around km 3.37 on OSM relation 10861494, about 10-15 m from the route.
